notes.title: From Vietnam to the Pacific: Radio Commander Returns with a New Challenge!
notes.content:
[h2]Attention, Commanders!
[/h2]
[b]5 years ago, on October 10th, 2019, we celebrated Radio Commander's release on Steam.[/b] We can't believe you've been with us for so long, and we're grateful for such a dedicated community. The game wouldn't be the same without your support and feedback.

[h2]Radio Commander's journey[/h2]
Since Radio Commander's release in October 2019, [b]the game has seen significant updates and improvements [/b]to refine its unique blend of strategy and communication mechanics. Early patches focused on fixing bugs and enhancing features based on player feedback. For instance, we introduced improvements like more detailed reports on unit strength and updated voice commands. These updates also fixed mission-related issues, saving errors, and localization bugs​.

In the following months, the team continued enhancing the game with new content, including custom mission tools, and more flexible unit management options. 

Additionally, we have actively engaged with the community to implement requests, such as introducing new units and enhancing the mission editor. Overall, [b]Radio Commander has evolved thanks to a dedicated community and a responsive development team.[/b] We thank you all from the bottom of our hearts.

[previewyoutube=rHMhbKhUzzI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's next?
[/h2]
If you loved the original Radio Commander and its intense wartime strategy, we’ve got exciting news for you. [b]The Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign demo is now live! [/b]Get ready to step into the command tent once again, but this time, the Pacific theater of World War II awaits your leadership.

In Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign, [b]we’re taking you to the vast and treacherous Pacific front[/b]. Much like the original, every order you give is crucial, and every radio transmission can shift the tide of battle—but now, you're facing an entirely new set of wartime challenges. From air raids to amphibious assaults, you’ll need to command like never before.

[h2]What You’ll Experience in the Demo
[/h2]
[h3]Familiar Mechanics, New Battles[/h3]
Dive right back into the mechanics you mastered in the first game, but now with new strategic elements tailored to World War II’s Pacific theater.

[h3]Mission on Nauru Island[/h3]
Take command of a thrilling mission on Nauru Island. You’ll coordinate operations against enemy forces, direct air, and ground units, and navigate the chaotic unpredictability of battle.

[h2]Why Play the Demo?[/h2]
[h3]Your Expertise Matters[/h3]
As a fan of the original game, we value your strategic insight. Your feedback after playing the demo will help shape the final game, ensuring it delivers an even better experience.

[h3]Get a Taste of the Action[/h3]
The demo offers a glimpse of what’s to come but remember, the game is still in development, and things may change. Also, note that progress from the demo won’t carry over to the full game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3232770/Radio_Commander_Pacific_Campaign_Demo/

[h2]Take Command Now![/h2]
Don’t miss this chance to return to the frontlines. Download the Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign demo, put your command skills to the test, and help us create the best war strategy experience yet.

We look forward to hearing your thoughts, commander! 
Radio Commander team

notes.title: Just like Radio Commander, but in... the Middle Ages? Only 10 days left!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Radio Commander![/h2]

Recently, we informed you about a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gameops/kings-orders-innovative-letters-based-strategy-game?ref=26uhzr]Kickstarter Campaign[/url] for a title that may be close to your heart. If you liked the idea behind Radio Commander, King's Orders might be right up your alley! The game contains similar gameplay solutions in a completely different setting of medieval Europe. If you enjoyed Radio Commander, we encourage you to visit King's Orders Kickstarter Campaign and support the project. 

[h2]What is King's Orders?[/h2]

In King's Orders, just like in Radio Commander - the greatest emphasis is placed on the uncertainty of information. Until you receive a feedback report, you have no information on whether the order was completed. You don't know if the battle was won or how your general performed. You can only make the best possible decision, send an order, and... wait for the report. 

Should you capture an enemy fortress on the march or try a siege? Would you rather recruit regiments of archers or rely on swift cavalry? Should you invest and hire the best generals or focus on discreet spies? Some will choose diplomacy. Others prefer to meet on battlefields. The choice is yours. Each King has a different strategy, and the path to success may differ for everyone. 

[h2]Kickstarter Campaign[/h2]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gameops/kings-orders-innovative-letters-based-strategy-game?ref=26uhzr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33336099/b9bfbe20db0a4979a686dda1bee2e1ed8408d4ce.png[/img][/url]

If King's Orders sounds like a game that you might enjoy, visit us on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gameops/kings-orders-innovative-letters-based-strategy-game?ref=26uhzr]Kickstarter[/url] and support the project. We appreciate every single pledge, as we heavily depend on our community during the development. 

Once the Kickstarter Campaign is over, we will send you an early access Steam Key and ask you to fill out the feedback survey for the game. We analyze all the answers and based on them, make the decisions regarding the updates, bugfixes, and all the new content that should be introduced to the game. Help us decide on the shape of King's Orders before the official launch. 

To all the players, who have already supported King's Orders - sincere thank you! 

Best regards,
Games Operators

PS. We have seen the questions regarding [b]Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign[/b] in the comments from the previous announcement. Although the game takes time to develop, the project is still moving forward. We will update you immediately once the game has something nice to show to you.

notes.title: It's time to go back in time and replace radios with... letters and horses?!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Radio Commanders![/h2]

If you like giving orders via radio and managing the battlefield in this way, maybe it's time to take it a step further? 

[b]King's Orders[/b] is a simplified historical strategy game with one key innovation. You command your armies by sending letters with orders. The messengers with orders will not only face a long and difficult journey to every corner of your kingdom but also many dangers!

We are excited to announce the launch of a crowdfunding campaign for [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gameops/kings-orders-innovative-letters-based-strategy-game?ref=5koaen)]King's Orders on Kickstarter[/url]. 

This announcement is accompanied by a trailer showcasing the game's key features. By supporting King's Orders on Kickstarter, you can secure access to the expanded preview version. 

[previewyoutube=MvKl55ik5Q0;full][/previewyoutube]
We want to involve the community in the title's development process, which is why crowdfunding campaign supporters can gain access to a special preview build, featuring even more maps and scenarios. The goal for the campaign is 10,000 €, and fundraising will last for 30 days.

For those interested in supporting the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gameops/kings-orders-innovative-letters-based-strategy-game?ref=5koaen)]Kickstarter[/url] campaign, we direct you to the campaign page. Thank you for your support! 

Best regards,
Games Operators Team

notes.title: Steam Awards 2022: Labor of Love
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Radio Commanders! [/h2]

Another year is slowly coming to an end. This means that another season full of crazy discounts and sales has started on Steam! All of the games from Games Operators are currently discounted during the Autumn Sale 2022. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/gameops/#browse]You can buy our games at discounts that go as deep as 80%![/url]

[h2]Labor of Love[/h2]

The developer behind Radio Commander, Serious Sim studio, is currently developing [b]Heading Out[/b], a narrative road movie racing game. Very experimental and unique, the developers do their best to create another memorable experience!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640630/Heading_Out__A_Narrative_Road_Movie_Racing_Game/

Still, it doesn't mean that the concept from Radio Commander has been forgotten! Another studio is currently working on a side entry to the RC series: [b]Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign[/b]! Take a look and follow the game if you want to order your units through the radio again! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621910/Radio_Commander_Pacific_Campaign/

The concept of gameplay that is based on map data is also very important to the Jutsu Games studio! If you are looking for something less realistic and want to protect your neighbor area from hordes of Infected, follow [b]Infection Free Zone[/b] on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465460/Infection_Free_Zone/

If you appreciate the direction that we are following, having the original Radio Commander in mind, please consider nominating Radio Commander in the Labor of Love category for the Steam Awards 2022.  Thank you for your support! 

Best regards,
Games Operators Team

notes.title: New Radio Commander game from our friends, Squadron Studio
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome, Radio Commanders![/h2]

We are happy to announce that our friends from Squadron Studio are making a spinoff of our game Radio Commander! Mind you, it's not a direct sequel to our game, but still - an amazing project by a new studio, that we fully support and root for! The last installment took you to the Vietnamese jungle. But this time you can test yourself on a greater scale - the whole ocean! Different places, and moments in modern history... WW2 Pacific Campaign!

[h2]Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign[/h2]

What changed and what's new?
[list]
[*] global approach - you can order your army in the Strategic Commander view
[*] tactical approach - you can order your troops through fiercest battles in a Tactical Commander view
[*] use brand new information tools - maps, radar, and mission board
[*] change history - make decisions that differ from historical and face their consequences
[*] feel like a real commander - we cooperate with real soldiers to record voice lines!
[/list] 

[h2]Add to Wishlist on Steam![/h2]

Are you interested in a new Radio Commander? Visit its Steam Page! and check its content! Don't forget to follow and wishlist if You want to be the first to get information about this project!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621910/Radio_Commander_Pacific_Campaign

Best Regards,

[b]Radio Commander Team[/b]

notes.content:

[b]King's Orders[/b] is very similar to Radio Commander in its basic premise, but the gameplay is full of its own unique characteristics. The game will require some strategic thinking, forcing the player to make his moves in advance. Prepare for huge medieval battles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33336099/8e9b6fdd8d4d3c800b9c96404c4902df114b6cdf.png[/img]

King's Orders is a simplified historical strategy game with an important innovation. You command thy armies by sending letters with orders. Messengers with letters travel the land and can be lost or intercepted. Generals execute orders once received and send you reports the same dangerous way.

Now with loyalty discount for owners of RADIO COMMANDER!

Features
[list]
[*]More than 6 hours of story missions full of cyberpunk themes, investigation and political intrigue.
[*]Real-time audio feedback from squad leaders brings life to the world of Cyber Ops.
[*]Different hacking mechanics to keep control of doors, security devices and cyberlink-equipped brains.
[*]Squad management: recruit new blood for the infiltration squads.
[*]Research and Development: develop new cyber-implants to improve the agents performance.
[*]Retro-futuristic computer interfaces and dark analog synth-based music inspired by 80's cult movies.
[/list]

notes.title: Fixes for Everyone & Future of RC Survey!
notes.content:
Welcome Commanders!

Three topics from your favorite(?) indie studio.

I FIXES FOR EVERYONE!

Some good news for all of you who are not interested in buying the DLC. All the fixes we’ve developed while working on the expansion are now implemented in the basic game. Patch will download automatically. Have fun!

Patch include:
- Various campaign fixes and redesigns (especially M5, M7, M8)
- Some quick battle bugs fixed
- Overall difficulty rebalance
- GUI and cursor fixes
- Waypoints and player waypoints problems fixed
- Mines system reinvented
- Resolution/aspect ratio issues
- Other small fixes


II DISCOUNT FOR BUNDLE

Radio Commander Complete Edition (basic game + Squad Management DLC) is now out on Steam with a 10% discount. If you don’t own Radio Commander already now is the perfect opportunity to play it the way it was meant to be played!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/14147/Radio_Commander__Complete_Edition/


III HELP US PLAN FUTURE OF RC

After finishing the DLC we’re planning our future roadmap and want to ask about  your opinion. Which direction should we choose in developing Radio Commander? Single player mini-campaign? Multiplayer coop/vs? Randomly generated sandbox campaign with dynamic objectives? Ports to other platforms? Linux version? Take part in our survey and tell us what you think! There are awards!

SURVEY: https://forms.gle/PvYY3UufcLWxH6VE6
